run_generate: run the Dia model generate method to produce audio output sequences from input tensors
build_logits_processors: build logits processors for Dia generation with classifier-free guidance and EOS delay pattern filtering
prepare_model_inputs: prepare model inputs for Dia generation with optional classifier-free guidance duplication
apply_delay_mask: apply the delay mask to force tokens during Dia generation instead of predicting them
prepare_inputs_for_generation: prepare inputs for Dia autoregressive generation with delay mask and CFG duplication
